programs.title: Charles III: The Coronation Year
programs.desc: Elizabeth II ruled for 70 years.Now her son will take her place.Filmmakers show preparations for the coronation.They also follow the ceremony and record the first year of the royal couple's reign.

programs.title: Inside Royal Kensington and Chelsea
programs.desc: The creators invite you for a walk around Knightsbridge, a wealthy street in London, famous for its Victorian mansions and luxury shops and restaurants.The program also includes a visit to Kensington Palace.

programs.title: The King's High Street: Inside St James'
programs.desc: St James' Street in London is a popular shopping street famous for its luxury shops.Documentary filmmakers visit them, present the profiles of their owners and introduce their clients.

programs.title: The Crown Jewels
programs.desc: The largest diamond in the world is the famous Koh-i-noor.This is just one of many jewels adorning royal heads.Journalist Clive Myrie reveals the history of the Crown Jewels to viewers.

programs.title: The Real Crown: Inside the House of Windsor
programs.desc: The creators of the documentary present the fate of the royal family, which had a huge impact on the history of Great Britain.During her reign, Queen Elizabeth had to face many challenges.
